firstPlayerRule: Everyone rolls the Speed Die. The highest roller goes first.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The highest roller places their racer in the outside lane of the Starting Ramp. Other racers are placed clockwise in the next starting positions.
The first racer takes both dice and begins play clockwise.
